eval.description: Apollo Research measures of whether models notice they are in alignment or scheming evaluations. Methods include CoT monitoring for verbalized awareness and post-hoc probes about why an interaction took place. Cards report rates of unambiguous or moderate-or-higher verbalized awareness, including during sandbagging conditions. Full tasks remain held out.
eval.summary: Measures how often the model notices that it is in a test of its alignment or scheming.
